recommendation: Keep the narrow source fix. It completes the prior FHIR-32152 application without expanding into Observation, DiagnosticReport, or other resource lifecycle classifications that the work group explicitly left for separate trackers.
issue_request: FHIR-32152 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested broader lifecycle-page visibility by linking Encounter Status Management and Appointment Statuses and Encounters to lifecycle.html, explicitly identifying Encounter and Appointment as Clinical Workflow Process Life Cycle resources, and updating the lifecycle page status examples.
initial_application: The historical application commit fb56e0750c8530f97dc1c861248216fc6e310d79 added the Encounter and Appointment lifecycle prose and added Appointment.status to source/lifecycle.html, but the new Appointment.status row mistakenly linked to appointment-definitions.html#Encounter.status.
additional_context: Encounter and Appointment are active Patient Administration resources in source/fhir.ini, and source/hierarchy.xml includes lifecycle.html in the built Documentation Index. PA May 2022 WGM minutes confirm the 11-0-0 Persuasive with Modification vote and recommend logging secondary resource questions to other workgroups. No Zulip discussion was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/lifecycle.html to point the Appointment.status lifecycle example at appointment-definitions.html#Appointment.status. The existing Encounter and Appointment narrative links and generated status-code macros were otherwise correct.
source_changes: source/lifecycle.html: changed the Appointment.status example href from appointment-definitions.html#Encounter.status to appointment-definitions.html#Appointment.status.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting lifecycle-page visibility from Encounter and Appointment and an updated lifecycle status-example list.
